notes.title: Small Update #1
notes.content:
- Fixed issue where the car remained suspended in the air when unstucking.
- Muting the music now also mutes Horde music.
- Parasites will now spawn farther away from the player.
- Removed the small Horde when spawning the first Foundation.
- It is now possible to place a Workbench on top of a Foundation.
- Fixed a bug that caused companions to duplicate when loading a new game.
- Updated materials required to build a Tire in the Mechanic Station.
